notes.title: Split Screen Fix for Triggering Cutscenes
notes.notes: [p]This is a super quick patch to make sure you can trigger cutscenes while playing in split screen![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666170/8e6c1a41da0cea5b14bb1f8d83dac7b97b5f48b5.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Added Controls for Inverting
notes.notes: [p]Not a ton of changes from the last build, but by popular demand you can now invert your controls! I also lowered the default sensitivity a bit.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666170/fcc1fa670c17cf05eb8ee00c93afc90911f6d4bc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: More traps have hit the ice! 🥅
notes.notes: [p]Alright Playtesters, [b]v0.0.2[/b] is live! First off, we’ve tossed in some [b]new traps[/b] - among them is a puck turret which is super fun to deal with fast runners and big waves![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45666170/5cfc0d18c5d793a2cc856ca066401fbbed4d0a33.gif"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also fixed the respawn system - which was broken in the previous build.[/p][p][/p][p]This is just the start - more updates coming soon![/p]
